calls.statement:
SELECT cs.format, COUNT(DISTINCT s.format) AS fmts_in_versions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_receipt_line,
       COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN store_id>=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_store_lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
       MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date)
FROM l

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS nb
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
    AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(receipts) AS receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS nb
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stores, SUM(m.receipts) AS my_rec, SUM(c.receipts) AS ctl_rec,
       ROUND(SUM(m.nb),2) AS my_nb, ROUND(SUM(c.nb),2) AS ctl_nb,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.receipts<>c.receipts OR abs(m.nb-c.nb)>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatched_stores
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS receipts_mixed_staff_flag
FROM (SELECT f.receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
      WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
